name: Kicker
notes: Companion Intelligence's texting assistant that picks your three priorities for the day, blocks time, syncs Oura, WHOOP, Fitbit and calendars, and shops through a paired Chrome so checkout runs in your own logged-in accounts. Free, per the Kicker team on 2026-10-21. Added after hands-on testing over iMessage.
tagline: Your AI friend that actually knows what's going on in your life
